agents.name: Economic Data Agent
agents.description: Retrieves and synthesises macro-economic data from government sources — Federal Reserve (FRED), Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), and U.S. Census Bureau. Provides national and regional context on consumer spending, income, demographics, housing, and employment. Use for macro-level trend analysis, regional comparisons, and economic benchmarking.

agents.name: Economic Taxonomy Agent
agents.description: Retrieves the taxonomy of the economic data
